# Do suspected stock-outs change the rankings? (generated by code/censoring_rank_check.py)

base = all eligible series, recorded sales as demand; clean = only series without suspected stock-out weeks in the test window; imputed = suspected weeks set to the series' mean weekly sales before the test period. Same cached forecasts throughout. Δ vs LGB-Q in % with 95% bootstrap CI (positive = LGB-Q needs less).
